name: hark-mobile
description: HARK companion app for Android and iOS: a Capacitor shell around the HARK web app (../public), with native notifications, haptics, keep-awake and an Android foreground service for background listening.

scripts.android: node scripts/copy-web.mjs && cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: node scripts/copy-web.mjs && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android: node scripts/copy-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
